description.en: Gunma Prefecture is an inland prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Gunma Prefecture has a population of 1,937,626 and has a geographic area of 6,362 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 群馬縣是位於關東地方西北部的一個內陸縣，該縣人口約187萬。群馬縣的行政中心是前橋市。
